card.name: Verbs and nouns before a how/which clause
card.fires_on: Verbs like decide, predict, determine, and nouns like instructions or consensus, right before a clause that says which, how or what. The next word is often a question-type word.

modes.label: Decision and prediction verbs
modes.description: Verbs such as decide, determine, predict or decided that lead into a which/how/what clause.
